findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** direct; pull the identity back along the bijection $p^*$, where it becomes the regular-section formula for the universal quotient section.

findings.excerpt: **Proof technique:** lexicographic well-founded induction on the pair $(r(f),\dim f(X))$, with defect the primary integer, using the simultaneous induction step of [F1].
